_readme: 這一份是 /history/ 每一站的「選擇」：Paul 2026-11-17 定的，每一站不是一張卡讓人點，是一個情境、兩三個選擇，
BT 像一位空服員，這一趟從頭到尾都在，你選哪一條都沒有對錯，選了就打開那一站的歷史。
**現在全部是範例**（demo 是 true）。Mentorship 與 Curriculum 照真的故事把每一站的字換掉，再把 demo 改成 false。程式一行都不用動。
attendant.intro_zh/en   一進機場那一句問候（BT 自我介紹、這一趟的規則：每一站你選，沒有錯的門）。
attendant.outro_zh/en   起飛之後最後那一句。
attendant.neutral_zh/en 不是從選擇進來（點年份帶、直接帶網址）時空服員說的那一句。
stops.<代號>            代號就是後台那一站的代號（網址 #後面那一段）。
ask_zh/en             那一站的情境，一兩句，用「你」。
choices[]             兩個或三個。label 是按鈕上的字，reply 是你選了之後 BT 回你的一句。沒有對錯，每一句都要讓人覺得選了也好。
fallback                後台新加的站如果這裡沒有，就用這一組，所以後台加站永遠不會壞。
紅線：不放任何人的名字；數字只用 ~/Anson/wiki/entities/beyond-taiwan.md 事實資料庫裡有的。對外字串改之前過 TW。

attendant.intro_zh: 你好，我是 BT。這一趟我從頭到尾都在。每一站你來選，哪一條都走得通，沒有錯的門。
attendant.intro_en: Hi, I'm BT, your attendant for this trip. I'm with you the whole way. At every stop you choose. Every door leads on, none of them is wrong.
attendant.outro_zh: 不管你接下來飛去哪，我們都在。
attendant.outro_en: Wherever you fly next, we're there.
attendant.neutral_zh: 不管你是怎麼走到這一站的，都好。這一站發生了這些事。
attendant.neutral_en: However you got to this stop, it's fine. Here's what happened here.

2020-founded.ask_zh: 2020 年。七個在不同時區的學生開了一通視訊，問你：要不要一起？
2020-founded.ask_en: 2020. Seven students in seven time zones are on a call. They ask: want to join?

choices.reply_zh: 一開始誰都不知道要做什麼，先來就對了。看看那七個人做了什麼。
choices.reply_en: Nobody knew what to do at the start either. Showing up was the whole job. See what those seven did.

choices.reply_zh: 很多人都是先看。看著看著就在裡面了。看看你在看的時候發生了什麼。
choices.reply_en: Most of us watched first. Watching is how you end up inside. See what happened while you watched.

2020-mentorship-begins.ask_zh: 有人問你：要不要配一位在國外念書的學長姐，每個月聊一次？
2020-mentorship-begins.ask_en: Someone asks: want a mentor who studies abroad, one call a month?

choices.reply_zh: 問題多是好事，這就是這件事開始的原因。看看第一批 36 個人怎麼開始的。
choices.reply_en: Questions are the point. That's why this started. See how the first 36 began.

choices.label_en: I don't know what to ask.
choices.reply_zh: 沒關係，第一通電話多半是對方在問你。看看第一批 36 個人怎麼開始的。
choices.reply_en: That's fine. On the first call, the mentor usually does the asking. See how the first 36 began.

choices.reply_zh: 可以，資料我們也會一直放著。想聊的時候，人還在。看看這件事是怎麼開始的。
choices.reply_en: You can. The resources stay up either way. When you want to talk, someone's here. See how this started.

2021-online-fair.ask_zh: 2021 年的一個晚上，一場線上博覽會，一百多個分組房間。你會？
2021-online-fair.ask_en: One night in 2021, an online fair, dozens of breakout rooms. You would?

choices.reply_zh: 那天晚上很多人就是這樣，從一間逛到下一間。看看那場有多少人來。
choices.reply_en: That's how most people spent that night, one room to the next. See how many came.

choices.reply_zh: 一間問到底也很好，那些回答後來變成了資料庫。看看那場有多少人來。
choices.reply_en: One room, all the way down, works too. Those answers became the database. See how many came.

2021-campus-ambassadors.ask_zh: 你的高中沒有人聽過 BT。要不要當第一個把它帶進學校的人？
2021-campus-ambassadors.ask_en: Nobody at your high school has heard of BT. Be the first to bring it in?

choices.label_en: Yes, I'll talk to a teacher.
choices.reply_zh: 第一句最難講，講了就有了。看看那一年的 18 位大使做了什麼。
choices.reply_en: The first sentence is the hardest. After that it exists. See what the 18 ambassadors did that year.

choices.reply_zh: 兩個人就是一個開始。看看那一年的 18 位大使做了什麼。
choices.reply_en: Two people is a start. See what the 18 ambassadors did that year.

2023-first-bootcamp.ask_zh: 暑假有一個四天的探索營，不用錢。你？
2023-first-bootcamp.ask_en: There's a four day bootcamp this summer. It's free. You?

choices.reply_zh: 好。第一屆就是這樣來了八十幾個人。看看那四天。
choices.reply_en: Good. That's how more than 80 people showed up to the first one. See those four days.

choices.label_en: My family might not let me.
choices.reply_zh: 很多人也是先過這一關。我們幫你跟家裡講。看看那四天發生了什麼。
choices.reply_en: A lot of people had that conversation first. We help you have it. See what happened over those four days.

choices.label_en: I don't think I'm good enough.
choices.reply_zh: 探索營沒有門檻，就是為了這句話開的。看看那四天發生了什麼。
choices.reply_en: There's no bar to clear. The bootcamp exists because of that sentence. See what happened over those four days.

2025-alumni-accounts.ask_zh: 你申請完了，結果也出來了。接下來？
2025-alumni-accounts.ask_en: You're done applying. The results are in. Now what?

choices.label_en: Come back and help the next one.
choices.reply_zh: 校友帳號就是為了這個開的。看看有多少人回來了。
choices.reply_en: That's what the alumni accounts are for. See how many came back.

choices.label_en: Live my own life for a while.
choices.reply_zh: 當然。門一直開著，什麼時候回來都算回來。看看有多少人回來了。
choices.reply_en: Of course. The door stays open. Whenever you come back counts. See how many have.

today.ask_zh: 現在。接近三十個幹部，分在七個國家，全部是學生。你會站在哪一邊？
today.ask_en: Now. Close to thirty organisers in seven countries, all students. Where do you stand?

choices.reply_zh: 好，等你。看看現在是誰在做這件事。
choices.reply_en: Good, we'll be here. See who's doing this now.

choices.reply_zh: 謝謝。看看你支持的是誰。
choices.reply_en: Thank you. See who you'd be supporting.

choices.reply_zh: 路過也歡迎。看看這一站。
choices.reply_en: Passing through is welcome too. Have a look around this stop.

choices.reply_zh: 好。看看這一站發生了什麼。
也可以。看看這一站發生了什麼。
choices.reply_en: That works too. See what happened here.
